notes: This portable C++ TCK case publishes the three adapter-configured ordinary application attributes through the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador API, then requests publication state through the standard MIM and decodes the reported attribute handles with public API services. It verifies the exact report includes those three application attributes and the inherited HLAprivilegeToDeleteObject defined by the 2025 MIM. The provider, application FOM, endpoint, callback model, class/attribute names, and MIM module are adapter-supplied. No DDM region APIs or vendor-specific test hooks are used by the test scenario.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void publishObjectClassAttributes( ObjectClassHandle const & objectClass, AttributeHandleSet const & attributes) = 0
